overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board did not discuss hiring in its Purpose 8 executive session, and the notice's "Finance Director staff hire" topic was specific enough. An unraised allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board entered executive session for an improper purpose (Purpose 8 preliminary screening for a Finance Director hire) at its February 25, 2014 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Board did not actually discuss any topics related to a hiring process during its February 5, 2014 executive session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the February 25, 2014 meeting notice lacked sufficient detail because it did not specify the position(s) for which the Board was considering or interviewing applicants.
allegations.key_passage: This topic was sufficiently specific to notify the public that the Board would be discussing hiring a Finance Director.

allegations.summary: May 22 complaint to the AG alleged the Board authorized legal counsel to respond to the March 3 complaint without first reviewing it; this was not in the original complaint to the Board.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation as it was not raised in the initial complaint filed with the Board.
